asset_set: Questionnaire Q18 option 2 — Standardizing filing systems

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under drawer and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; faint horizontal file-tab lines on drawer via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: calm methodical order energy — approachable admin craft, not tedious drudgery
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint cool #F0F4FF highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: sky blue appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on drawer edge and label maker
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under drawer and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: pulls a color-coded folder from the open drawer
left_hand.grip: pinch grip on the folder tab edge
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: applies a fresh label tab with the label maker

pose.gesture_summary: mid-file freeze frame — the label tab pressing into place
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: clipped to shirt pocket edge — no face in frame

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of tidy hands pulls a color-coded folder from an open filing drawer while the other applies a fresh sky-blue label tab, capturing the satisfying click of an organized system falling into place. The scene reads as methodical calm, not tedious drudgery.

primary_objects.name: filing cabinet drawer
primary_objects.detail: open drawer edge with rows of upright folder tabs

primary_objects.name: color-coded folder
primary_objects.detail: sky-blue tab edge, no readable text

primary_objects.name: label maker
primary_objects.detail: small blank label strip feeding out

primary_objects.name: label tab
primary_objects.detail: blank color tab, no printed text

subject.environment: quiet records room strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, neutral shelving suggestion only

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from drawer → folder → label maker
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
composition.thumbnail_readability: drawer silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter C, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, cluttered messy office, paper shredding chaos, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Standardizing filing systems". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms in a crisp steel-blue office shirt with sky-blue #81D4FA cuff piping. Left hand pinches a sky-blue tabbed folder pulled from an open brushed-steel filing drawer. Right hand presses a violet label maker applying a fresh blank sky-blue tab. A ballpoint pen clips to the shirt pocket edge. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, generous transparent margins, quiet records-room strip fading to transparent. Mood: calm methodical satisfaction, tidy admin craft not tedious drudgery. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size.
